SELECT pbac.PROJECT_COMPARE_ID, pbac.PROJECT_ID , pbac.business_access, (select v.MEANING from sys_code_value_b_v v where v.code = 'BUSINESS_ACCESS' AND v.code_value = pbac.business_access) business_access_n, pbac.project_access_items, pbac.items_detail, pbac.check_result, ( SELECT sc.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v sc WHERE sc.code = 'CHANCE.CHECK_RESULT' AND sc.code_value = pbac.check_result ) check_result_n FROM project_business_access_compare pbac
pbac.business_access = (case (SELECT DISTINCT(fou.UNIT_CODE) FROM sys_user su INNER JOIN sys_user_allocation sua ON sua.USER_ID = su.USER_ID INNER JOIN FND_EMPLOYEE_ASSIGNS fea ON fea.employee_assign_id = sua.employee_assign_id INNER JOIN fnd_employee em ON em.employee_id = fea.employee_id INNER JOIN fnd_org_unit fou ON fou.unit_id = fea.unit_id where su.user_id = #{userId}) when 'RISK_AUDIT_DEPARTMENT' then 'FACTORING_PROJECT_FX' when 'MINISTRY_LAW_DEPT' then 'FACTORING_PROJECT_FW' when 'EXAMINATION_APPROVAL_DEPARTMENT' then 'FACTORING_PROJECT_SP' else 'unknown' end ) and pbac.project_id=#{projectId}

SELECT pbac.PROJECT_COMPARE_ID, pbac.PROJECT_ID , pbac.business_access, pbac.project_access_items, pbac.items_detail, pbac.check_result, ( SELECT sc.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v sc WHERE sc.code = 'CHANCE.CHECK_RESULT' AND sc.code_value = pbac.check_result ) check_result_n FROM project_business_access_compare pbac
pbac.project_id=#{projectId}
select ac.business_access, ac.project_access_items from hls_business_access_compare ac where ac.BUSINESS_ACCESS like 'FACTORING_PROJECT_%'
